senses.gloss: (= שבשב, cmp. שׁוֹבָב) to run in all directions, blunder.
to entangle, confound; part. pass. מְשׁוּבָּשׁ; f. מְשׁוּבֶּשֶׁת thrown into confusion.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35">Lev. R. s. 35</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:12">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 11</cite> <he>וטלפות סוסיהן מִשְׁתַּבְּשׁוֹת</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>משתמטות</he>) and the hoofs of their horses were entangled (caught in the mud).
